name: What is the typical process for a home repair project with Maine Results, Inc.?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for a home repair project with Maine Results, Inc.?

acceptedAnswer.text: The typical process for a home repair project with Maine Results, Inc. begins with an initial consultation where we discuss your needs and assess the repair. Following this, we provide a detailed proposal and estimate. Once approved, we schedule the work at your convenience. Our carpenters then execute the repair, keeping you informed of progress. Upon completion, we conduct a final walkthrough to ensure your satisfaction. This structured approach helps ensure clarity and quality throughout the project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Maine Results, Inc.'s repair process includes consultation, proposal, scheduling, repair execution, and a final walkthrough for quality assurance.
